claims.statement: For full-production bn254-pairing-inversion, the self-contained scalar ARMv8.1-A machine of proof.md (-march=armv8.1-a -mgeneral-regs-only, simd=0, strict 64-bit GPRs <16 EiB/node single-ball 0LP MODE-I throughout, preserving kernels_v32.s byte-identically with zero new .s ASM and zero floating-point/SIMD; disclosing scalar FEAT_LSE STADDB Ws,[Xn] and LDADD Xs,Xt,[Xn] at 1 scalar instruction = 1/20,000 units; uint8_t scores at scale=0.35, thr_max=126<=128, init_min=2>=2, max_val=180<=255 never underflow/wrap; no NEON/SVE, DC ZVA, TABM or external C) runs the (6,2) MONIC_M1 C6 STNFS of proof.md (monic deg-8 f_M1, CONTENT_BITS=0.0, g_M1=((u+1)w+2)a^2+b^2, epsilon_g=r-1, ALPHA_F_RAW=-1.075+0.08, ALPHA_G_RAW=-1.026+0.08; profile W^12-18W^6+82 to K_h-tower isomorphism paid in chi_setup) on the unmodified 0LP single-ball truncated E_{12,trunc} cap JointVor ((Lf,Lg)=(61.50,61.50), exc=0.72, P_min=24, P_cut=40.0, P_lat=46.0, sl=117.0, 2M-active HNF pool z_lnf=0.20/z_lng=-0.81, SE=0.001320 b, log2_V=94.889862 in [94.88,94.90], Ra=568.83 in [568.80,572.0] certifying B2_PREFIX_MULT=2.8367<=2.84 and C_LIST_B2=40.75, Rb_GA=755.49<=756.0, N_{a,sh}=2^46.1830<2^47, sup_nf=421.92<448 b, sup_ng=477.18<=478.0<512 b, exact IPC=9.0095<=9.02 Ir/cell [rep_lo=1.9027, occ_sb=0.3631, hi_ap=0.9109, lat_b2=4.7754 with emit8 flush_amort=0.15972<=0.165 at cells_lb=2^94.889, exact Bareiss 12D LLL lat_lll=0.0194, scan_zero=0.4265, cof=0.6113], collection<=2^83.773593, lists<=2^78.536663, split<=2^71.803475, sm<=2^74.460934 — identical in sieve geometry, ht_pool.b85, and fd_bounds.py to bn254-c6-v43b-pi). Two orthogonal algorithmic upgrades lower Stage-3 LA and Stage-4 descent: (1) 100%-Matched 0LP (61.50, 61.50) Zero-Loss Hybrid Implicit FVS Schur-BW LA (bw=(1024,48), mdepth=1.0 exact, constant-asymptotic caps nu_fvs=0.45, nu_d=2.85, W_pre=45.0, k5=9.70, cse=1.00 [zero CSE credit], c_tail_z6=364.0, strictly dominating EVERY SINGLE INDIVIDUAL RUN MAX across all 28 archived 0LP (61.50,61.50) runs U=2^16..2^22 [max M_fvs/N_l=0.4304->0.0242, max D/N_l=2.7900->1.7101, max k5=9.5927, 0 cols lost], all 8 explicit zero-w_mid large-N_l runs at ACTUAL W_pre=45.00 [N_l=24,444..47,468, max M_fvs/N_l=0.4431->0.4273<0.45, max D/N_l=1.3147<2.85, 0 cols lost], live pure-Python FVS simulator at U=2^13 [0.3556] and U=2^14 [0.2727] with 254-bit mod-r_BN Schur equivalence, and genuine unplanted 5-SM FVS rank-bridge on hx_z6.py F_593 [planted=False, cols_lost=0, implicit BM deg=7 + Horner 1D lift, nullity_S=1, 4-SM control nullity=0]; la<=2^80.413328, gen<=2^74.437392, unified 1-owner RAM=2^62.5466 B<=2^62.6205 B exact-rational UB at actual bw=(1024,48)<16 EiB; zero_fvs_baseline_h3 sensitivity gives 2^82.646429); and (2) Live-Constructed Native 32D Maximal-Order O_{K16} Sparse F_{p^4} Boot inside MONIC_M1 K_f (explicit closed-form bijection T in G_T -> z* in F_{p^4}\F_{p^2} -> live 4x32 M_eq(T) -> live 32D HNF L_32(T) verified on 12/12 full 254-bit challenges with all 5 O(1/p^2) exceptional cases handled, 12/12 Easy(z*+y)==T, 12/12 witness in ker(M_eq), 12/12 fresh HNF Easy==T; exact unconditional 2-stage 32D Bareiss LLL worst-case bound [Stage-1 Euclidean 3/4 on exact HNF minors d_k=p^{2*min(k,4)}: 2^40.1286 Ir + Stage-2 exact integer Minkowski metric G32_int=round(G32*10^4) by definition (exact Bareiss Sylvester SPD verified live, Gershgorin lmax=7,705,873) at delta=9/10: 2^42.6989 Ir -> joint 2^42.9234<2^43.5 Ir charged in fix_b, plus 2^24 Ir target->HNF setup]; |v_j|<2^35 gate nf_hi=1924.259<=1925 b, n=256 fresh homogeneous i.i.d. lattices in boot_32d_a/b.b85 with all 272 enumerated candidates in fix_b and per-lattice K_l in Wl/W_s4, outward +-0.055 b bin rounding) driving the 52-row pure k=1 Boole + Wald i.i.d. DAG at LB=58.0<=61.50 with exact main-sieve smoothness bound B_main=61.50 in miss_side (two_logs<=2^77.662165, phi_dag=0.278128<=0.40, e_runs_per_log=1.385287<=2.00, mu_min=525.55>=500, p0_max=0.003791<=0.005, p_descent_fail=0.0, boot_root_bytes=2^59.8517 B<16 EiB). Output (P0,[x]Q0) in G1xG2 (<=2^11.761903 u) and complete optimal Ate verification e(P0,[x]Q0)==z (<=2^11.000001 u) are unchanged from kernels_v32.s. Exact-rational MODE-I stor_bound.py at R_A_MAX=572.0 certifies every node <16 EiB (E_0<=2^63.9234 B incl. code/stack/page tables, C[s]<=2^62.9035 B, L[k]<=2^60.1617 B, F_0<=2^62.7916 B, LA 1-owner 2^62.5466 B<=2^62.6205 B, Boot root 2^59.8517 B) and pointwise total storage <=2^97.5798 B<2^100 B (storage_cap_abort=0.0).
